description: This file defines the HumanRelayHandler class which manages human-mediated interactions with an AI model, including message creation, token counting, and prompt completion. It also includes utility functions for message content extraction and user dialog handling.

classes.name: HumanRelayHandler
classes.description: Handles human relay interactions for AI message processing, including creating messages, getting model info, and completing prompts.

methods.name: countTokens
methods.description: Returns a promise resolving to 0, counting tokens in the provided content.

methods.name: createMessage
methods.description: Creates a message flow, prompts user via dialog, and relays response.

methods.name: getModel
methods.description: Returns default model information for human relay.

methods.name: completePrompt
methods.description: Copies prompt to clipboard, prompts user, and returns response.
